annotations.title: Indicative flood and cyclone damage to a building or asset

description:
Indicative damage to a building or asset at a place from river and coastal flooding and tropical cyclone wind: expected annual damage as a share of its value and in money, and the 50 to 500-year events, low, central and high; today, or RCP4.5 or RCP8.5 in 2050 and 2080 (wind to 2050).

Use for what flooding could cost a home, a property or loan collateral, and ESRS E1, IFRS S2, TCFD or EU Taxonomy screening. Give asset_value for money in its currency, which any one building needs; without it the money is for all buildings of its class in the point's 1 km cell, in euros, never one building's. Indicative, not a valuation: pass the caveats on.

asset_class.description: What the asset is: residential, commercial or industrial buildings, transport, roads or agriculture

asset_value.description: The asset's replacement value, to have the damage in money; without it a building's damage is priced at the replacement cost of its class's buildings in the point's 1 km cell, in euros

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of asset_value, echoed; nothing is converted

language.description: Language code for the name of the place found (resolved_from); the rest of the answer is English

place_name.description: A place name or street address; add the country after a comma when ambiguous (Portland, Maine)

protection_rp.description: The return period in years the site's flood defences hold; FLOPROS's when omitted

response_format.description: concise (default) answers the question; detailed adds every field the sources give

scenario.description: historical for today, or rcp4p5 or rcp8p5 with a year

name: estimate_financial_impact

attribution.description: The credit the licence asks for when it is retold

name.description: The feed's name as it is cited

ratio.description: Share of the replacement value lost a year, 0.01 is 1 %

value.description: ratio x asset_value, in its currency; null without a value

subdivision.description: Its first-order subdivision (state, province, region), from Natural Earth's admin-1

category_at_100_years.description: Cyclone wind: the Saffir-Simpson category of the 100-year wind. The hazard's strength: a low damage band says what it costs a year, not that storms are weak there

damage_at_return_periods.description: Per site: never add across sites

ratio.description: Share of the replacement value that flood takes, undefended

return_period.description: Years: the flood with that chance, 1 in return_period, each year

band.description: XDI's rating of the hazard's central expected annual damage: low, moderate, high

band_at_high_end.description: The same rating of the range's high end: a wider risk than `band` says

family.description: acute or chronic, as EBA Pillar 3 and the EU Taxonomy file it

hazard_group.description: temperature, wind, water or solid_mass: the EU Taxonomy's group, EBA Pillar 3's hazard columns

material.description: From XDI's moderate band up, on the central value

taxonomy_hazard.description: Its hazard in Appendix A to the EU Climate Delegated Act

code.description: ISO 3166-2, or none where the subdivision has no code

annual_damage_risk_band.description: XDI's rating of the sum's central share: low, moderate, high

asset.description: What was priced; amount_at_risk is the value given where any hazard is material, else 0, as EBA Pillar 3 reports a carrying amount

caveats.description: What the estimate cannot tell; pass them on with the numbers

credit.description: How a retelling credits the answer: Source: Criora with a link to the page the answer is about, then each originator whose data it quotes in the words its licence asks for. Concise, each credit once; detailed, by source with its name and licence, criora first

hazards.description: river_flood, coastal_flood and, where IRIS covers the place and year, cyclone_wind

indicative.description: Always true: an estimate for screening and disclosure, not a valuation

resolved_from.description: What a place name was resolved to; null when coordinates were given

title: Indicative flood and cyclone damage to a building or asset
